  @Test(expectedExceptions = IllegalStateException.class)
  public void throwsIt() { new BEpsTest().boom(); }

  public void throwsJunit() { boom(); }

  public void throwsArray() { boom(); }
  void boom() { throw new IllegalStateException(); }
}
